mapper.sql: SELECT p.*, t.code AS tax_code, t.rate AS tax_rate, t.inclusive AS tax_inclusive FROM products p LEFT JOIN tax_rates t ON t.id = p.tax_rate_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO products (sku, barcode, name, description, category_id, tax_rate_id, uom, price, cost, image_url, active) VALUES (#{sku}, #{barcode}, #{name}, #{description}, #{categoryId}, #{taxRateId}, #{uom}, #{price}, #{cost}, #{imageUrl}, #{active})
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET sku = #{sku}, barcode = #{barcode}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, category_id = #{categoryId}, tax_rate_id = #{taxRateId}, uom = #{uom}, price = #{price}, cost = #{cost}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, active = #{active}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE products SET active = #{active}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
